core.title: Split Finish Electronic Keypad Deadbolt, Emtek E1000US15xUS3

text.description_html:
Emtek E1000, Arched Keypad Front Door Lock

House keys are a thing of the past. Instead of carrying around keys, all you need is a single code. The Arched Keypad Front Door Lock can be programmed with up to 20 codes and comes factory programmed with 2 unique codes so you can use your new deadbolt right away. The Electronic Keypad Deadbolt is operated by a keypad or key on the exterior side, and by a thumb turn on the inside. The Electronic Lockset is made from solid brass and has a split finish. The exterior is US15 satin nickel and the interior is US3 Polished brass.

Features of the Emtek E1000 Touchpad Deadbolt:

  • Will fit standard 2-1/8" door preparations.
  • Easy to use installation and programming instructions included.
  • Factory programmed with 2 unique, secure user codes for use right out of the box.
  • Can be programmed with up to 20 user codes of your choice.
  • Codes can be added and deleted.
  • Easy lock operation, simply push the Emtek button and turn the exterior thumb turn to lock.
  • Easy unlock operation, enter the 4 digit code and turn the exterior thumb turn.
  • Programming changes can be made easily using the keypad.
  • Illuminated keypad for easy and quick operation after dark.
  • Low battery indicator lets you know when it’s time to change the battery.
  • Backup Keyway: Schlage C
  • Hardened steel bolt.
  • Used 9-volt battery

Specifications for the Electronic Deadbolt:

  • Finish: Exterior: US15 Satin Nickel/ Interior: US3 Polished Brass
  • Exterior Width: 3"
  • Exterior Height: 6-3/8"
  • Exterior Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Interior Width: 3"
  • Interior Height: 6"
  • Interior Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Keypad Height: 2-3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" - 2-1/4"
  • Backset: either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Package includes: latch, strike plate, and 9-volt battery.

Sold Individually
